CAUDALIO 4.4 adds up to eight independent canvases in a single show. Each canvas has its own board, timeline, resolution and output routing. Global Play, Pause, GO, Stop and video Blackout controls operate across the show.

Saving, recovery and media collection include every canvas. Existing projects open as one canvas. Keep backups: shows saved in 4.4 require CAUDALIO 4.4 or later. The illustrated guide now includes a multi-canvas chapter in English, French and Spanish.

Downloads: Linux amd64 (Ubuntu 24.04 / Mint 22) and Windows x64. The macOS installer is still undergoing final preparation and is not included in this release.

The native release checks cover the core engine, interface, timelines, monitoring, chroma key and multi-canvas behavior, plus installation and media decoding. Physical projectors, capture devices, external audio, NDI and long-duration show loads require rehearsal on the target hardware. Global transport is not frame-locked synchronization.

14-day trial. Existing licence and project data are preserved by the upgrade.
https://caudalio.net/fr/download/
